text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Oka Sho has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume can only challenge this race
once in
their lifetime. Because of that,
many aspire to run
in it... and seize the
tiara for their year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That means today will be Nishino
Flower's first
and final Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
choice_data_list: （絶対に後悔なく走り切ってほしい……！）

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
choice_data_list: フラワー、体は平気？大丈夫？

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine! Oh, um... You were really
thorough
during our strategy recap, too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I realize that I've been so anxious I've
been
double-checking things with her
over and over
again.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
choice_data_list: 君の大事なレースだから
貴方の大事なレースだから

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry. I've worked really hard in

preparation for today, you know!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: So... I know today will go well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's not just saying that either. Nishino
Flower is
the perfect picture of calm
right now.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I've been feeling that way since this
morning. I'll
run the way I want to...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
And at the end, you'll be waiting for me
with a
proud smile. I've been picturing it
all day.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I feel like today's race will tell me what I
want to
know...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'll be able to find out why I became
race-ready
so early!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She flashes me a bright smile. Behind
her, the
cheers from the crowd roar in
from the far end of
the tunnel.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Don't take your eyes off me, okay,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Just have faith, and wait for me!
